ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the diagram, what type of consumer are rodents?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the lower left corner of the picture there are “Plants” plants, above the plants there is a “Rodent” rodent, and the arrow points from the plants to the rodent; next to it there is also a “Grazer” label, indicating this type of animal that feeds on plants. Reasoning: Plants are producers, and rodents obtain food from plants, so they directly eat producers. Consumers that directly eat producers belong to primary consumers, so rodents are Primary Consumer.
